dialogues.jp:
俺は中庭のベンチに腰を下ろすと、買ってきた
惣菜パンの袋を取り出した。
dialogues.en:
I sat down on a bench at the courtyard, taking out the bread
I bought.
dialogues.text:
I sat down on a bench at the courtyard, taking out the bread
I bought.

dialogues.jp:
こうして、うららかな風に吹かれつつとる昼食
もまた、風情のあるもので……。
dialogues.en: This wind is perfect for whetting the appetite...
dialogues.text: This wind is perfect for whetting the appetite...

dialogues.jp: （あれ？　開け口は……どこだ？）
dialogues.en: "(Huh? How do you... open this?)"
dialogues.text: "(Huh? How do you... open this?)"

dialogues.jp: 袋を開けようとした指先が思わず｛さまよ／彷徨｝う。
dialogues.en: I traced my fingertip over the top of the bag.
dialogues.text: I traced my fingertip over the top of the bag.

dialogues.jp:
『ここから開きます』と書いてあるあたりを撫
で回してみるが一向にそれらしい切れ目などは
見つからない。
dialogues.en:
There was a sign "Please Open Here", but it didn't look any
different from the rest of the bag.
dialogues.text:
There was a sign "Please Open Here", but it didn't look any
different from the rest of the bag.

dialogues.jp:
しからば、と横っ腹を引っ張って口を開けさせ
ようとするが、敵も｛さ／然｝るもの、なかなかこちら
の思い通りにはいかなかった。
dialogues.en: But there's no way I'm going to let this defeat me!
dialogues.text: But there's no way I'm going to let this defeat me!

dialogues.jp:
袋ごと揉みくちゃになったパンからハムカツの
中身がべろりとはみ出す。
dialogues.en:
I grabbed the bag and started jostling around with the
supposed opening, attempting to rip it apart.
dialogues.text:
I grabbed the bag and started jostling around with the
supposed opening, attempting to rip it apart.

dialogues.jp:
それがなんだかアカンベーをしているように見
えてイライラはますます募っていく。
dialogues.en: Yet, no matter how my hands worked, my efforts were useless.
dialogues.text: Yet, no matter how my hands worked, my efforts were useless.

dialogues.jp: （く、くそっ！　パンの分際で生意気な！）
dialogues.en: "(D, damnit! How annoying!)"
dialogues.text: "(D, damnit! How annoying!)"

dialogues.jp: ワイルドに歯で噛み千切ってやろうか！！
dialogues.en: I started ripping at it wildly with my teeth!
dialogues.text: I started ripping at it wildly with my teeth!

dialogues.jp: 悪戦苦闘する俺の上に、すっと影がおちた。
dialogues.en:
As my fierce battle with the dastardly bag continued, a
shadow hovered over me.
dialogues.text:
As my fierce battle with the dastardly bag continued, a
shadow hovered over me.

dialogues.jp:
誰かに覗き込まれているな、とは思ったが今の
俺に顔をあげる余裕などない。
dialogues.en:
Someone was peering at me, but all my concentration was
focused on the irritant.
dialogues.text:
Someone was peering at me, but all my concentration was
focused on the irritant.

dialogues.jp: 「大変そうだな、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Having a little trouble, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Having a little trouble, Asakura?"

dialogues.jp: この声は……。
dialogues.en: This voice is...
dialogues.text: This voice is...

dialogues.jp:
「工藤か、見てのとおり、俺はとりあえず取り
　込み中だ」
dialogues.en: "Kudou. As you can see, I'm in the middle of something now."
dialogues.text: "Kudou. As you can see, I'm in the middle of something now."

dialogues.jp: 額からぼたぼた汗を落としながら答える俺。
dialogues.en: Sweat dripped off the brow of my forehead as I answered him.
dialogues.text: Sweat dripped off the brow of my forehead as I answered him.

dialogues.jp:
このビニールは新型の特殊フィルムでできてい
るに違いない。
dialogues.en:
This must be a new type of vinyl they're using for the
opening...
dialogues.text:
This must be a new type of vinyl they're using for the
opening...

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺に工藤は心なしか呆れたような調子で
続ける。
dialogues.en: Kudou continued to stare amazed at my behaviour.
dialogues.text: Kudou continued to stare amazed at my behaviour.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……俺、ハサミなら持ってるけど？」
dialogues.en: "...I do have a pair of scissors, you know."
dialogues.text: "...I do have a pair of scissors, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なんですと！？」
dialogues.en: "Whaaaat!?"
dialogues.text: "Whaaaat!?"

dialogues.jp: そこで初めて俺は顔をあげた。
dialogues.en: I finally lifted my head up to look at him.
dialogues.text: I finally lifted my head up to look at him.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、これでいいか？」
dialogues.en: "This'd do, right?"
dialogues.text: "This'd do, right?"

dialogues.jp:
差し出された工藤の｛てのひら／掌｝には、ごくごく小さくま
さに手のひらサイズのハサミが乗っかっていた。
dialogues.en:
There in his presented palm, lay a small, easily-carriable
pair of scissors.
dialogues.text:
There in his presented palm, lay a small, easily-carriable
pair of scissors.

dialogues.jp: 「工藤、すばらしすぎるぜ！　恩に着る」
dialogues.en: "Kudou, well played! I'm in your debt!"
dialogues.text: "Kudou, well played! I'm in your debt!"

dialogues.jp:
……ぱちん。ビニールの隅に小さく切れ目を入
れると、いとも簡単に袋は口を開けた。
dialogues.en:
...Snip. With one small motion, the vinyl was snapped and
the bread packet easily opened.
dialogues.text:
...Snip. With one small motion, the vinyl was snapped and
the bread packet easily opened.

dialogues.jp: ビバ、文明の利器。
dialogues.en: Viva to the convenience of culture.
dialogues.text: Viva to the convenience of culture.

dialogues.jp:
それにしても、さっきまでの苦労はなんだった
というのだろう……。
dialogues.en: All my troubles just now, solved within seconds...
dialogues.text: All my troubles just now, solved within seconds...

dialogues.jp:
俺はやっと安堵の息を吐いて、すっかり形の変
わったハムカツサンドを袋から引っ張り出した。
dialogues.en:
I sighed in relief, and took out the ham-bacon sandwich from
the bag.
dialogues.text:
I sighed in relief, and took out the ham-bacon sandwich from
the bag.

dialogues.jp:
諦めたと見えてすっかり大人しくなりおって
……早速、ぱくりとかぶりつく。
dialogues.en: No more hope for you now, get in mah belly!
dialogues.text: No more hope for you now, get in mah belly!

dialogues.jp:
「しかしお前、……よくハサミなんて持ってた
　な」
dialogues.en:
"...Man, I didn't expect you to be carrying scissors with
you."
dialogues.text:
"...Man, I didn't expect you to be carrying scissors with
you."

dialogues.jp:
もごもごとハムカツサンドを｛そしゃく／咀嚼｝しながら、俺
が言うと。
dialogues.en: I spoke before taking a bite out of the sandwich.
dialogues.text: I spoke before taking a bite out of the sandwich.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「備えあれば憂いなしだ」
dialogues.en: "Being prepared for anything is a good trait to have."
dialogues.text: "Being prepared for anything is a good trait to have."

dialogues.jp: なんとも模範的な答えが返ってきた。
dialogues.en: Examplary behaviour, indeed.
dialogues.text: Examplary behaviour, indeed.

dialogues.jp:
憂いがなかろうが嬉しかろうが、備えっていう
言葉には縁がない俺とは大違いだ。
dialogues.en: Too bad our ideals hardly ever meet.
dialogues.text: Too bad our ideals hardly ever meet.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、貸してもらっといて何だが、何とも
　切りにくいハサミだな」
dialogues.en:
"It's so small though, I almost thought it wouldn't be able
to open the packet."
dialogues.text:
"It's so small though, I almost thought it wouldn't be able
to open the packet."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あはは……俺もそう思うよ」
dialogues.en: "Ahaha, I thought so too."
dialogues.text: "Ahaha, I thought so too."

dialogues.jp: ハサミの形はしていたが、何しろ小さい。
dialogues.en: It's really quite tiny, that pair of scissors.
dialogues.text: It's really quite tiny, that pair of scissors.

dialogues.jp:
持ち手には指が一本やっと入るか入らないかく
らいの穴が開いているだけで、ろくに刃もつい
てはいない。
dialogues.en:
It was about as long as an extended finger, and it's blades
looked quite blunt.
dialogues.text:
It was about as long as an extended finger, and it's blades
looked quite blunt.

dialogues.jp:
「どこでそんなハサミ買ったんだ？　不良品だ
　よ、そりゃ」
dialogues.en: "Where did you buy it from? Methinks you got ripped off."
dialogues.text: "Where did you buy it from? Methinks you got ripped off."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「どーでもいいだろ」
dialogues.en: "What~ever."
dialogues.text: "What~ever."

dialogues.jp: ま、そう言われれば、そうだが。
dialogues.en: Oh well, if that's how it is.
dialogues.text: Oh well, if that's how it is.

dialogues.jp: ……まてよ。
dialogues.en: ...Waitaminute.
dialogues.text: ...Waitaminute.

dialogues.jp:
（……女の子が持ってるお裁縫セットって、確
　かああいうちっこくて切りにくいハサミが入っ
　てたよな……）
dialogues.en:
"(...I'm pretty sure one of those portable sewing sets that
girls carry around would have scissors about that size...)"
dialogues.text:
"(...I'm pretty sure one of those portable sewing sets that
girls carry around would have scissors about that size...)"

dialogues.jp:
――などとつらつら考えを巡らせつつパンをか
じっていると、工藤が妙に改まった口調で切り
出した。
dialogues.en:
--As my mind raced through the possibilities, Kudou
nervously opened his mouth to talk.
dialogues.text:
--As my mind raced through the possibilities, Kudou
nervously opened his mouth to talk.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あのさ、朝倉。頼みがあるんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura... Can you do me a favour?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura... Can you do me a favour?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What's it about?"
dialogues.text: "What's it about?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「もうすぐ卒業式だよな」
dialogues.en: "The graduation ceremony is coming up soon."
dialogues.text: "The graduation ceremony is coming up soon."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「んぁ」
dialogues.en: "Mmmah."
dialogues.text: "Mmmah."

dialogues.jp: もふもふとパンを口に含んだまま答える。
dialogues.en: I answered while chewing on my food.
dialogues.text: I answered while chewing on my food.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、卒業したところで本校に繰り上がるだけ
だけどな。
dialogues.en:
Even after we graduate, we'd just be going a few steps away
to the main school.
dialogues.text:
Even after we graduate, we'd just be going a few steps away
to the main school.

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺にとってはまったくと言っていいほど
無味乾燥な儀式だ。
dialogues.en:
If anything, it can be considered a pretty darned useless
ceremony.
dialogues.text:
If anything, it can be considered a pretty darned useless
ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あのさ、朝倉さ」
dialogues.en: "You know, Asakura..."
dialogues.text: "You know, Asakura..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「お前のさ」
dialogues.en: "About something you have."
dialogues.text: "About something you have."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「んん」
dialogues.en: "Mmm?"
dialogues.text: "Mmm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「制服のさ」
dialogues.en: "Your uniform."
dialogues.text: "Your uniform."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「んんん」
dialogues.en: "Mmmm?"
dialogues.text: "Mmmm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「第２ボタンさ」
dialogues.en: "The second button."
dialogues.text: "The second button."

dialogues.jp: ……ああ、まだるっこしい奴だな。
dialogues.en: ...Man, stop beating around the bush.
dialogues.text: ...Man, stop beating around the bush.

dialogues.jp:
「なんだよ、言いたいことがあんならはっきり
　言えよ」
dialogues.en:
"What is it? If you have something to say, out with it
already!"
dialogues.text:
"What is it? If you have something to say, out with it
already!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「悪い、ちょっと言いづらくて……」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, it's kinda hard to say..."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, it's kinda hard to say..."

dialogues.jp:
工藤はちょっと真剣な顔になり、小さく呼吸を
整えておもむろに切り出した。
dialogues.en:
With as serious a face as I've seen, he took a short breath
and spit it out.
dialogues.text:
With as serious a face as I've seen, he took a short breath
and spit it out.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「お前の制服の第２ボタン、俺にくれよ」
dialogues.en: "Would you please give me your uniform's second button?"
dialogues.text: "Would you please give me your uniform's second button?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Buuwaaaa!!!!!!"
dialogues.text: "Buuwaaaa!!!!!!"

dialogues.jp:
思いもよらぬ申し出に、口中のものを噴出して
しまう俺。
dialogues.en:
The food in my mouth became fertilizer for the grass in the
courtyard.
dialogues.text:
The food in my mouth became fertilizer for the grass in the
courtyard.

dialogues.jp:
「おおお前！　そんな趣味があったのか！？
　いや、ダメだ俺は、そんな……」
dialogues.en: "Y, y, y, you! You swing that way!? No, I can't, that's..."
dialogues.text: "Y, y, y, you! You swing that way!? No, I can't, that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「違う違う、俺が欲しいんじゃないったら」
dialogues.en: "No, no! It's not me who wants it!"
dialogues.text: "No, no! It's not me who wants it!"

dialogues.jp:
｛とっさ／咄嗟｝に後ずさる俺に、工藤は慌ててぶんぶんと
首を振った。
dialogues.en: Kudou hastily responded to my confused exclamation.
dialogues.text: Kudou hastily responded to my confused exclamation.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「俺の知り合いの子に頼まれたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "It's a request from a person I know."
dialogues.text: "It's a request from a person I know."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あ――なんだ、そうか」
dialogues.en: "Ah-- so that's how it is."
dialogues.text: "Ah-- so that's how it is."

dialogues.jp:
俺はほっと胸を撫で下ろした。まったく、一時
はどうなることかと思ったぜ。
dialogues.en:
I stroked my chest to calm myself down. What was I thinking
there...
dialogues.text:
I stroked my chest to calm myself down. What was I thinking
there...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ずっとお前に憧れてたんだってよ。自分じゃ
　頼みづらいからってさ」
dialogues.en:
"You've had an admirer for quite a while. Didn't have the
guts to tell you directly, though."
dialogues.text:
"You've had an admirer for quite a while. Didn't have the
guts to tell you directly, though."

dialogues.jp: 陰ながら俺を慕ってくれる婦女子がいたとは。
dialogues.en:
So there's been a girl who's had a crush on me for this
long?
dialogues.text:
So there's been a girl who's had a crush on me for this
long?

dialogues.jp: （どうだ音夢、少しは兄を見直したか？）
dialogues.en: "(How's that Nemu, what do you think of me now!?)"
dialogues.text: "(How's that Nemu, what do you think of me now!?)"

dialogues.jp:
遠いお空の妹に、意味もなくテレパシーを送っ
てみたりする。
dialogues.en:
I tried to communicate through telepathy to my sister,
wherever she was.
dialogues.text:
I tried to communicate through telepathy to my sister,
wherever she was.

dialogues.jp:
ふと、かすかな疑惑が頭をよぎり、俺は念を押
すように尋ねた。
dialogues.en:
But with a slight nagging doubt still in my head, I decided
to make certain.
dialogues.text:
But with a slight nagging doubt still in my head, I decided
to make certain.

dialogues.jp: 「待てよ、その知り合いって、女の子だよな？」
dialogues.en: "Wait a minute. This person you know, it's a girl, right?"
dialogues.text: "Wait a minute. This person you know, it's a girl, right?"

dialogues.jp:
工藤本人ではなくとも、やっぱり男でした〜な
んてオチをつけられちゃたまらない。
dialogues.en: I'm not going to make the same mistake twice.
dialogues.text: I'm not going to make the same mistake twice.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「当たり前だろ」
dialogues.en: "Obviously."
dialogues.text: "Obviously."

dialogues.jp:
なにをバカな、とでも言いたげな目をむける工
藤。
dialogues.en: "Are you stupid?" His eyes spoke volumes.
dialogues.text: "Are you stupid?" His eyes spoke volumes.

dialogues.jp: はあ、一安心。
dialogues.en: Haaah, relief.
dialogues.text: Haaah, relief.

dialogues.jp:
そうなってくると｛にわ／俄｝かに相手の子への好奇心が
高まってくる。
dialogues.en: Now with the natural order ensured, my curiosity was piqued.
dialogues.text: Now with the natural order ensured, my curiosity was piqued.

dialogues.jp: 「で、どんな子なんだ？　可愛いのか？」
dialogues.en: "Then, what does she look like? Is she cute?"
dialogues.text: "Then, what does she look like? Is she cute?"

dialogues.jp: 俺はダイレクトにたずねた。
dialogues.en: I went straight to the point.
dialogues.text: I went straight to the point.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「え？　そうだな………………ショートカット
　で、和装の似合う女の子だよ」
dialogues.en:
"Eh? Well...... imagine a girl with short hair, dressed in a
kimono."
dialogues.text:
"Eh? Well...... imagine a girl with short hair, dressed in a
kimono."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「へぇ〜。着物の似合う女の子っていいよな。
　やまとなでしこっていうの？　俺、けっこー
　タイプかも」
dialogues.en:
"Heh, a kimono-wearing girl sounds good. That's a yamato
nadesico* right? I like that type of girl."
dialogues.text:
"Heh, a kimono-wearing girl sounds good. That's a yamato
nadesico* right? I like that type of girl."

dialogues.jp:
不必要に男に媚びぬ、慎ましく楚々とした立ち
姿。日本男児であれば｛かよう／斯様｝な女子をこそ側に置
きたいものであるッ！
dialogues.en:
A girl who dotes on her man, modest, graceful and neat.
There's no Japanese man who'd turn down that kind of girl!
dialogues.text:
A girl who dotes on her man, modest, graceful and neat.
There's no Japanese man who'd turn down that kind of girl!

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうか」
dialogues.en: "I, I see."
dialogues.text: "I, I see."

dialogues.jp:
拳を握り締める俺を見て、工藤は何故かほのか
に頬を染めた。
dialogues.en:
Looking up from my clenched fist, Kudou's face was oddly
red.
dialogues.text:
Looking up from my clenched fist, Kudou's face was oddly
red.

dialogues.jp: 「……何故赤くなる？」
dialogues.en: "...Why are you blushing?"
dialogues.text: "...Why are you blushing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「！　………………っな、なんでもない！」
dialogues.en: "! ......N, nothing!"
dialogues.text: "! ......N, nothing!"

dialogues.jp: ベンチから立ち上がり、ぱんと腰をはたく工藤。
dialogues.en: Kudou immediately jumped up from the bench.
dialogues.text: Kudou immediately jumped up from the bench.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、約束だからな？　ま、お前のボタン欲
　しがるような女子はそうそういないだろうし、
　大丈夫か」
dialogues.en:
"T, then, it's a promise, right? The girl who wants it won't
be there, but it'd be alright, I bet."
dialogues.text:
"T, then, it's a promise, right? The girl who wants it won't
be there, but it'd be alright, I bet."

dialogues.jp:
にっ、と笑う工藤に俺は握り締めた拳を小さく
突き出した。
dialogues.en:
Kudou smiled a little, and tapped my clenched fist with his
finger.
dialogues.text:
Kudou smiled a little, and tapped my clenched fist with his
finger.

dialogues.jp:
「甘く見てもらっちゃ困るな工藤、俺は意外性
　に溢れた男なんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't underestimate me, Kudou. I'm a man of many
surprises."
dialogues.text:
"Don't underestimate me, Kudou. I'm a man of many
surprises."

dialogues.jp:
「卒業式当日ともなれば俺の第二ボタンを巡っ
　て、婦女子達が血で血を洗う抗争をだな……」
dialogues.en:
"That I would give my second button away on the day of
graduation, there may well be bloodshed amongst my many
suitresses."
dialogues.text:
"That I would give my second button away on the day of
graduation, there may well be bloodshed amongst my many
suitresses."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい、そりゃ見物だな」
dialogues.en: "Right, right, that'd be fun to watch."
dialogues.text: "Right, right, that'd be fun to watch."

dialogues.jp:
工藤はいつもの、呆れたような笑顔のまま、さっ
さと校舎へ戻っていった。
dialogues.en:
With his usual wry smile, Kudou returned to the school
building.
dialogues.text:
With his usual wry smile, Kudou returned to the school
building.

dialogues.jp:
最後に奴が言い放った、「お前最近、杉並に似
てきたんじゃないか？」という不名誉な台詞は
あえて聞かなかった事にする。
dialogues.en:
His parting shot, "You've been acting a lot like Suginami
lately, haven't you?", was disgraceful by anyone's
standards.
dialogues.text:
His parting shot, "You've been acting a lot like Suginami
lately, haven't you?", was disgraceful by anyone's
standards.

dialogues.jp: 「……それにしても」
dialogues.en: "...In any case."
dialogues.text: "...In any case."

dialogues.jp: 和装の似合う女の子、か……。
dialogues.en: A kimono-wearing girl, huh...
dialogues.text: A kimono-wearing girl, huh...

dialogues.jp: なぜか口元が自然とゆるむ。
dialogues.en: My jaw started to slacken subconciously.
dialogues.text: My jaw started to slacken subconciously.

dialogues.jp: なんだか、卒業式が楽しみになっていた。
dialogues.en: Looks like this graduation will be a fun one.
dialogues.text: Looks like this graduation will be a fun one.

dialogues.jp: ◆第二ボタン◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Second Button◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Second Button◆

dialogues.jp:
工藤が、卒業したら第二ボタンをくれないかと
言いだした。
dialogues.en:
Kudou asked me to give him my uniform's second button when
graduation day arrived.
dialogues.text:
Kudou asked me to give him my uniform's second button when
graduation day arrived.

dialogues.jp: その申し出に｛きょうがく／驚愕｝した俺だが、
dialogues.en: The way he phrased it scared me half to death,
dialogues.text: The way he phrased it scared me half to death,

dialogues.jp:
真相は、知り合いの女の子（着物が似合うショー
トカットの女の子らしい）が俺の第二ボタンを
欲しがっているという事だった。
dialogues.en:
but the actual situation was that a girl that Kudou knew
(with short hair and wearing a kimono) wanted the second
button.
dialogues.text:
but the actual situation was that a girl that Kudou knew
(with short hair and wearing a kimono) wanted the second
button.

dialogues.jp:
一安心した俺は、その後、まだ見ぬ和服の女の
子に想いを馳せるのだった。
dialogues.en: Relieved, I quickly gave my assention to the act.
dialogues.text: Relieved, I quickly gave my assention to the act.
